arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS mastercard_credit_transactions FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id WHERE c.card_brand = 'Mastercard' AND c.card_type = 'Credit'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions made with Mastercard cards whose card type is Credit.
assumptions: Credit cards means card_type = 'Credit' exactly, excluding 'Debit' and 'Debit (Prepaid)'.
The count covers all transactions regardless of whether they have a fraud label, as in the earlier question.
The data covers 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31, so the count covers that whole period.
